h2: Plumber Ubud – Private Service for Villas & Houses
intro: If your villa in Ubud has a dripping mixer, a cistern that won't shut off, or water pressure that drops every time someone runs the shower upstairs, you need a plumber who knows how these hillside properties actually work. I come myself, trace the cause through pumps, tanks and pipes, and fix it on the spot — no call centre, no hand-off.

sections.h3: How Ubud's Slopes and Humidity Change Plumbing
sections.text: In Sayan and Tegallalang, villas sit on slopes fed by spring water or private wells. That setup means pumps run harder, pressure dips when multiple taps open at once, and air pockets build up in pipes over weeks. Layer Ubud's constant dampness on top and you get corroded fittings, swollen bathroom door frames, and mould creeping behind tiles. Diagnosing the real source matters more here than anywhere else on the island.

sections.h3: Typical Jobs I Handle Around Nyuh Kuning and Peliatan
sections.text: Most calls from villa managers in this stretch are familiar: a mixer that drips non-stop, a cistern refilling endlessly, low pressure on the upper floor, or a washing-machine hose splitting at the joint. I swap out traps, hoses and mixers, install new toilets and basins, hook up dishwashers or laundry machines, and service well filters or UV units if they're due.

sections.h3: What to Send Me on WhatsApp Before I Arrive
sections.text: A couple of clear photos or a ten-second video of the problem area go a long way. Show me the leaking tap, the inside of the cistern, or the pump panel — whatever is acting up. That lets me bring the correct parts so we sort it in one visit instead of two. Pricing depends entirely on the job; once I see your photos I'll reply with a straightforward quote right there in the chat.

Leaves land in every gutter, skimmer and drain almost daily around Ubud's river valleys. Clear pool filters weekly and check downpipes for moss before the rainy season hits. Keep bathroom extractor fans running even when nobody is showering to fight the damp. Give hose connections under sinks a quick look each month — humidity here accelerates corrosion far faster than coastal air does.

faq.q: Do you cover villas in Sayan, Tegallalang and surrounding areas?
faq.a: Yes, I travel across Ubud including Penestanan, Nyuh Kuning, Peliatan and the rice-terrace villages. Drop me a message on WhatsApp and we'll work out a time that suits you.

faq.q: How do I get a price for a plumbing repair?
faq.a: Snap a photo or short video of the issue and send it via WhatsApp. I'll assess what needs doing and reply with a quote based on the actual work involved — no fixed rate sheet.

faq.q: Can you handle both the plumbing fix and pool equipment in one visit?
faq.a: If your villa has a pump, filter or UV system needing attention alongside a tap or pipe repair, yes. I bring both sets of parts so everything gets sorted in a single trip rather than scheduling two separate visits.
